projects.title: HTTP exchange classifier
projects.completeScope: Classify the three real loopback exchanges as CSS GET, query GET and JSON POST, preserving method/path/status/media boundaries.
requiredEvidence: Classifier output and one header-vs-body explanation

projects.title: Precise greeting resource
projects.completeScope: Implement exact GET greeting path recognition, percent decoding, trimming, blank/extra-segment rejection and a stable JSON envelope.

limitation: This new bounded classroom implementation is separate from the historical original full projects. Loopback HTTP does not qualify a native browser, another OS or every HTTP input.
minute_fields_scope: projects[].minutes retains the historic supplied source budget; it is not the current candidate schedule or a measured completion time.

candidate_planning.shorter_slot_policy: Arrange an explicit taught continuation; retain all required projects and evidence. A minute table does not prove novice feasibility.
